+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from ahra.alignment_session import (
+    ALIGNMENT_DECISION_OUTPUT,
+    REQUIREMENT_DRAFT_OUTPUT,
+    AlignmentSessionTimeoutError,
+)
+from ahra.goal_operations import M1_PROFILE_REF
+from ahra.ports import AgentRunRequest
+from ahra.workflow_a_cli import (
+    WorkflowAFixtureDriver,
+    advance_session,
+    approve_requirement,
+    draft_request,
+    start_session,
+)
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+EXAMPLE = ROOT / "examples" / "intents" / "phase1-example-intent.yaml"
+
+
+class HangingWorkflowADriver:
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.requests: list[AgentRunRequest] = []
+
+    async def run(self, request: AgentRunRequest) -> object:
+        self.requests.append(request)
+        await asyncio.sleep(3600)
+        raise AssertionError("hanging driver should be cancelled by the timeout")
+
+
+class WorkflowACliTimeoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_advance_timeout_records_structured_resumable_snapshot(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
+            root = Path(temp)
+            session = root / "session.json"
+            start_session(intent_path=EXAMPLE, session_path=session, profile_ref=M1_PROFILE_REF)
+
+            with self.assertRaises(AlignmentSessionTimeoutError) as raised:
+                asyncio.run(
+                    advance_session(
+                        session_path=session,
+                        message="This turn will hang.",
+                        actor="human:maintainer",
+                        driver=HangingWorkflowADriver(),
+                        timeout_seconds=0.05,
+                    )
+                )
+
+            error = raised.exception.to_dict()
+            self.assertEqual(error["code"], "agent_driver_timeout")
+            self.assertEqual(error["expectedOutput"], ALIGNMENT_DECISION_OUTPUT)
+            saved = json.loads(session.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            self.assertEqual(saved["stage"], "awaiting_user")
+            self.assertEqual(saved["lastError"]["code"], "agent_driver_timeout")
+            self.assertEqual(saved["lastError"]["expectedOutput"], ALIGNMENT_DECISION_OUTPUT)
+            self.assertTrue(saved["lastError"]["resumable"])
+
+            resumed = asyncio.run(
+                advance_session(
+                    session_path=session,
+                    message="Complete the frozen requirement.",
+                    actor="human:maintainer",
+                    driver=WorkflowAFixtureDriver(),
+                    timeout_seconds=1,
+                )
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(resumed["snapshot"]["stage"], "awaiting_requirement_approval")
+            self.assertNotIn("lastError", resumed["snapshot"])
+
+    def test_draft_timeout_records_structured_resumable_snapshot(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
+            root = Path(temp)
+            session = root / "session.json"
+            request_draft = root / "request-draft.json"
+            approval = root / "approval.json"
+            start_session(intent_path=EXAMPLE, session_path=session, profile_ref=M1_PROFILE_REF)
+            asyncio.run(
+                advance_session(
+                    session_path=session,
+                    message="Complete the frozen requirement.",
+                    actor="human:maintainer",
+                    driver=WorkflowAFixtureDriver(),
+                    timeout_seconds=1,
+                )
+            )
+            approve_requirement(session_path=session, actor="human:maintainer")
+
+            with self.assertRaises(AlignmentSessionTimeoutError) as raised:
+                asyncio.run(
+                    draft_request(
+                        session_path=session,
+                        request_draft_path=request_draft,
+                        approval_path=approval,
+                        driver=HangingWorkflowADriver(),
+                        timeout_seconds=0.05,
+                    )
+                )
+
+            error = raised.exception.to_dict()
+            self.assertEqual(error["code"], "agent_driver_timeout")
+            self.assertEqual(error["expectedOutput"], REQUIREMENT_DRAFT_OUTPUT)
+            saved = json.loads(session.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            self.assertEqual(saved["stage"], "frozen")
+            self.assertEqual(saved["lastError"]["code"], "agent_driver_timeout")
+            self.assertEqual(saved["lastError"]["expectedOutput"], REQUIREMENT_DRAFT_OUTPUT)
+            self.assertTrue(saved["lastError"]["resumable"])
+            self.assertFalse(request_draft.exists())
+
+            resumed = asyncio.run(
+                draft_request(
+                    session_path=session,
+                    request_draft_path=request_draft,
+                    approval_path=approval,
+                    driver=WorkflowAFixtureDriver(),
+                    timeout_seconds=1,
+                )
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(resumed["sessionPath"], str(session))
+            saved = json.loads(session.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            self.assertEqual(saved["stage"], "request_drafted")
+            self.assertTrue(request_draft.exists())
+            self.assertNotIn("lastError", saved)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
